description: Georgia's day-ahead electricity forecast published by JSC Georgian State Electrosystem: hour-by-hour total consumption, total supply, thermal / hydro (regulated and seasonal) / wind generation, and planned import and export, in MWh. Published daily, typically a day ahead.

date.description: The forecast date as 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Defaults to today in Tbilisi. Tomorrow is usually already published; older dates stay available.

name: gse_demand_forecast
